Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-04.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: Do you think this is a game? Don't say you're trying your best! I know you're not! Now, fight!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; tab == 1

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-06.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: Thanks for your help. I'm Erica. Although I couldn't kill him, I was able to get what I needed. Azrael dropped this earlier, during the fight. It's a Stone of Commune! You've been looking for it, right?
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; tab == 1

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-01.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: For my sake and for the sake of my followers, I cannot surrender now! Are you with me?
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; !tab == 1

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-03.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: Damn! Missed him again! Oh, it's you! Keep that up and you'll never defeat Azrael nor obtain the Stone of Commune. If you get another chance, try harder, OK?
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; !tab == 1

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-05.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: I'm not doing this for your amusement. This is a fight I can't withdraw from. There's no room for you here. Wait your turn.
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; !st == st2; tab == 1

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-07.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: Thanks for your help. I'm Erica. Although I couldn't kill him, I was able to get what I needed. Azrael dropped this earlier, during the fight. It's a Stone of Commune! Do you want it?
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; !st == st2; tab == 1

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-02.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: I'm not fighting only for myself! I won't give you this chance! Will you withdraw?
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; !st == st2; !tab == 1

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-08.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: You won't escape again, Azrael! Oh, there you are! Take the Stone of Commune I gave you earlier to the Tablet of Vision. You can use the stone to communicate with the tablet.

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-010.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: This Stone of Commune is a key that unlocks the forbidden power that resides within the Tablet of Vision. I don't have any use for it anymore. Take it with you. Thank you for your help. If we meet again, I won't forget what you've done for me!

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-011.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: Here it is. I hope to see you again someday. Goodbye!

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/4-09.htm.text: Erica Ken Weber: Take the Stone of Commune to the Tablet of Vision. Communicate with the tablet and you'll obtain forbidden power!
